text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the day of a fan meetup event— A 
massive amount of high-end catered food 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Caterer
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? We definitely received a reservation 
from Lady Gentildonna, but...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I have no recollection of that whatsoever. 
It is likely some scoundrel posing under 
my name.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"It happens from time to time. Harassment 
directed at me, or our family."

text_block_list.name: Caterer
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...!? If it gets cancelled like 
this, we'll be in the red...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Rest assured. I shall eat every last bite.
choice_data_list: What!? You're eating all of that?
What!? You're eating all of that?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Of course. They are probably expecting to 
see me flustered and panicked.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My, how adorable. To think you actually 
believe you've bared your fangs at me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, allow me to teach you. That 
something of this magnitude will not shake 
a "Gentildonna"—
choice_data_list:
I'll overeat if I'm by myself, so let's 
call in reinforcements.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that so? If that's the case—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Those hors d'oeuvres are MINE!! I'm gonna 
pile 'em all on top and make meat chazuke!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
To think she was trying to eat all this by 
herself... That's just so like 
Gentile-san...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Please, don't hold back. Hohoho... Events 
like this aren't so bad once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna chatted and laughed pleasantly 
as she shared the food with her 
companions.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Break time is limited, after all. Shall we 
get something to eat right away?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
These hors d'oeuvres are simply marvelous. 
The flavors of each ingredient complement 
one another beautifully.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
With this, I could eat as much as I want. 
Perhaps I should become a regular here 
from now on?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Gentildonna devoured the 
massive spread of food all by herself.
